newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse grants Cheung Kong waivers.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse grants Cheung Kong waivers.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd (CKI) said the Hong Kong bourse has granted them two listing rules waviers.

The Hong Kong Stock Exchange has granted a wavier to allow CKI's public float to stand at 15.4 percent, less than the required 25 percent level, with the remaining 84.6 percent stake to be held Hutchison Whampoa Ltd following a group restructuring, the companies said in a joint statement.

The exchange has also granted Cheung Kong a wavier from strict compliance with the rule restricting a controlling shareholder of a recently-listed company from disposing of its controlling interest, the statement said.
Such wavier has been granted subject to Cheung Kong retaining ultimate control of CKI, it said.
Earlier this week, the Cheung Kong group of companies including CKI, Hutchison and Hong Kong Electric Holdings Ltd announced a major corporate reshuffling.
Under the reshuffle, Cheung Kong is to transfer its CKI stake to Hutchison, which will hold 84.6 percent of CKI.
